page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring all storage operations to be handled via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.g9i.xlarge offers predictable compute performance. It is suitable for workloads requiring consistent CPU resources without the performance fluctuations of burstable models, such as mid-tier web servers, application hosting, containerized microservices, and small-scale databases.
